text: You helped mine a cursed gem deep underground — but your gear is now cracked, rusted, and humming strangely.
rules:
+1 point for Heavy and Metall Items
–1 points for Broken Items

text: You joined a raid to prove your strength, but dropped your weapon into the campfire mid-battle. They laughed. A lot.
rules:
+1 points for Rusty and Sharp items
-1 points for Beautifull Items

text: You were invited to her court. On arrival, she said your armor was "visually offensive" and banished it.
rules:
+1 points for Leather and Light Items
–1 point for Dirty Items

text: You where sent too slay the troll of the forest! It is now dead but all your stuff is stinky from the swamp!
rules:
+1 point for Cloth and Scary item
-1 point for cursed items

text: You tried to steal back the crown he already stole. You failed, and your gear was stolen in return. How ironic.
rules:
+1 point for Cool and Gold items
+3 point if you have a Cloak
–1 point for Heavy armor

text: You helped fix the royal automaton. It exploded. Now your armor smells like oil and gnome fear.
rules:
+1 point for Metal or Light items
-1 point if you dont wear a Hat
+1 point for items with abilitys

text: You followed him into the frost wastes. Your gear froze solid — and then he used it as firewood.
rules:
+1 point for Fur or Two-handed weapons
+1 point for Shouting-related titles
–1 point for Jewelry

text: You accepted a dinner invitation. He fed you blood soup and laughed. Everything you wore is now permanently crimson.
rules:
+1 point for Black, Silver or Blood-related gear
+1 point if you have Neckwear
–1 point for Holy items

text: You tried to barter with her for wisdom. She turned your cloak into a toad. It's still croaking.
rules:
+1 point for Waterproof or Slimy items
–1 point for Dry or Flammable items

text: You were sent to return a book. You tripped, fell into a magical archive, and your gear was "repurposed" by sentient robes.
rules:
+1 point for Magic items
+1 point for wearing Robes
–1 point for Metal gear

text: You helped prepare a royal feast but slipped into the meat grinder. You survived. Your gear didn’t.
rules:
+1 point for Fur or Bone items
+1 point if you own a Backpack (to carry meat)
–1 point for Vegetable-themed gear

text: You were sent to guard her eggs. You sat on the wrong one. Now your armor is covered in venom and guilt.
rules:
+1 point for Green or Scaled items
+1 point for Neck items
–1 point for Shiny metal gear

text: You tried to bless one of his skeletons. He hexed your helmet, and now it moans in church Latin.
rules:
+1 point for Bone, Dark, or Cursed items
+1 point for Skulls
–1 point for Holy or Shiny items

text: You brought him a puppy. He gave you a sticker and confiscated your sword for being "too pokey."
rules:
+1 point for Colorful or Soft items
+1 point if you own a Pet
–1 point for Scary-tagged items

text: You were asked to help organize his treasure hoard. You sneezed near a pile of rubies. You were... relocated. Forcefully.
rules:
+1 point for Gold, Gemstone, or Fire-related gear
+1 point if you wear Red or Scaly gear
–1 point for Water-tagged or Rusty items

text: You tried to trade with the goblins. They paid you in fireworks. Your backpack is now mostly ashes.
rules:
+1 point for Explosive, Chaotic, or Improvised gear
+1 point for gear tagged Junk or Recycled
–1 point for Elegant or Regal items

text: You helped him tie his boots. He mistook you for a rock and sat on your gear. It’s flatter now.
rules:
+1 point for Big, Two-handed, or Heavy gear
+1 point if you have Boots
–1 point for Tiny or Fragile items

text: You joined them on a night hunt. A bear stole your helmet. It looked better on the bear anyway.
rules:
+1 point for Wooden, Natural, or Camouflage items
+1 point for Hooded gear
–1 point for Metal or Royal-looking items

text: You helped rebuild his bridge. Your armor was used as temporary scaffolding and is now part of the structure.
rules:
+1 point for Stone, Heavy, or Crude items
+1 point for Regenerating gear
–1 point for Shiny or Fancy gear

text: You joined a royal cheese-tasting. The fondue pot exploded. You still smell faintly of Gruyère.
rules:
+1 point for Small, Quiet or Cloth-based gear
+1 point for any Pet (especially mice)
–1 point for Big weapons
